text: Shimizu et al. (2023) distinguish the general four-step SCAT coding description from the six-step implementation in this one study: (1) enter data in the SCAT form; (2) cut individual data into strips and classify similar strips together; (3) assign other terms to summarize each data group (this means rewording each group, not reorganizing it); (4) conceptualize potential themes from relationships between groups; (5) write a storyline incorporating all data; and (6) write a theory based on the conceptualization. This six-step list describes the study's application only.
